tasks.title: Every status reader drops private incidents before deriving public output
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, all Files/Behavior/Checks/Completion evidence; R7, corrected R6 consumer use and status Counterexamples. Pin the merged contract 1.8.0 full SHA and update bun.lock with bun install. Apply isPublicManualIncident to raw objects before proxy cleaning, poller validation or feed/badge parsing; project accepted incidents with publicManualIncident where specified. The shared guard rejects accessor-defined privacy keys without invoking getters. Preserve the proxy's null representation of malformed non-object items, older-api behavior, public feed ids and browser-safe runtime contract imports through /pulse-contract/index.js. Cover proxy, SSR, browser poller, resolved history, feed and component state with hide-details on/off and all four literal sentinels, with a legacy public positive control. Update docs and provide security, failing-on-main and test CPU evidence; deploy owns compose-e2e.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; with hide-details on and off, /api/manual-incidents, GET /, /feed.atom and /badge/component/api.svg contain 0 occurrences of DRAFT-7f3a, INTERNAL-5d17, NOTE-2b8e and UPD-9c41. The public control remains, web is down from its major impact, api retains its check-derived state, and the control feed id is manual:<control id>:0. Poller results, including resolved history, contain only projected public items; malformed non-object proxy items remain null and legacy public items without metadata remain accepted. Focused coverage may fail the global threshold.

exit 0; the repository's existing browser accessibility checks pass.
Against a local fake API with a public control and private sentinels, a live status request shows the control and 0 private sentinel occurrences; the PR records command and response evidence.
exit 0; record test_cpu_s for the branch and the pre-change main SHA on the same machine, with both numbers in the PR as requested by Performance impact.

PR names the pre-change main SHA and proves draft/internal tests fail there; explicitly identifies notes/draft-update tests as already-passing regression guards. It records check/check:a11y results, live smoke and before/after CPU evidence, and tests/commands for the applicable Security impact privacy/accessor boundary and dependency-pin checks. Contract is pinned to its merged 1.8.0 full SHA, unrelated pins and the proxy allow-list are unchanged, no credentials or admin routes are forwarded, and browser contract imports remain served through /pulse-contract/index.js.
